description: Source code for E2 network client factory, including SCTP connection handling, message packing/unpacking, and notifier classes for E2AP PDUs within the ocudu project.

classes.name: sctp_to_e2_pdu_notifier
classes.description: Converts packed E2AP PDUs from the E2 gateway into unpacked PDUs and forwards them to the E2 agent.

classes.name: e2_to_sctp_pdu_notifier
classes.description: Converts unpacked E2AP PDUs from the E2 agent into packed PDUs and forwards them to SCTP gateway.

classes.name: e2_sctp_gateway_client
classes.description: Manages SCTP connection to the E2 network, handling connection requests and message forwarding.

methods.name: handle_e2_connection_request
methods.description: Establishes SCTP connection and returns a notifier for E2 message handling.
